      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",

      "text": "Avoid heap allocations in IsWitnessStandard for Taproot inputs by checking witness size and the last element before calling ToSpans",
      "quote": "checking witness.size() >= 2 and witness.back() upfront before calling ToSpans() avoids that allocation.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author addressed in a separate commit and Yudis-bit tested ACKed",
      "author_replies": ["c:6280847772"],

      "status_by_id": "c:6282408300",
      "status_by_quote": "Tested ACK d3fb8e8 on Windows."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6234391822",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Iterate directly over scriptWitness with a counter in the P2WSH check to avoid allocating a vector of spans",
      "quote": "Iterating directly over scriptWitness with a counter avoids allocating the vector of spans without doing O(n^2) indexing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author addressed in a separate commit and Yudis-bit tested ACKed",
      "author_replies": ["c:6280847772"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6282408300",
      "status_by_quote": "Tested ACK d3fb8e8 on Windows."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6395031310",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "VerifyWitnessProgram calls witness.ToVectors() before checking the witness version, causing a 91 MiB allocation and verification slowdown for unknown witness versions",
      "quote": "VerifyWitnessProgram calls witness.ToVectors() before it looks at the witness version, so the valid \"1 tx, max empty wit elems\" block from the description still allocates about 91 MiB, now during scri",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined, explaining deserialization cost reduction is prioritized over post-PoW validation costs",
      "author_replies": ["c:6745317376"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6745317376",
      "status_by_quote": "I don't think your patch is important here. Script validation happens *after* PoW is checked on a block"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6503407615",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Touching 76 files with 1000+ lines for an interim data layout before localizing transaction access introduces unnecessary churn instead of first abstracting data access",
      "quote": "Instead pushing 17 commits touching over 1000 lines in 76 files, just to establish an implementation that is proven better but not proven best, should we maybe concentrate on the task that would allow",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "purpleKarrot confirmed author's explanation resolved their concerns",
      "author_replies": ["c:6655976837"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6680106731",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks for the explanation @sipa. I think that resolves my concerns."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6575922328",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Split the PR into three parts: interface and caller conversion, serialized representation, and deserialization checks",
      "quote": "Would it make sense to split this into (1) the `CScriptWitness` interface and caller conversion (e41dd47 through 9e22357), (2) the serialised representation, and (3) the deserialisation checks?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agrees splitting is reasonable and awaits further reviewer consensus",
      "author_replies": ["c:6655976837"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6655976837",
      "status_by_quote": "That sounds pretty reasonable; the PR has grown a bit beyond its original intentions and it may be worth splitting up."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6680106731",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Agree on encapsulation and API design of vocabulary types first before changing internal data layouts",
      "quote": "I would still prefer another approach: 0. Let's agree that encapsulation on Core's vocabulary types provides us a benefit by itself, and that we want to utilize it here.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that bug fixes should not be blocked on refactoring consensus and this PR will not hinder future encapsulation",
      "author_replies": ["c:6745317376"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6745317376",
      "status_by_quote": "This PR is a bug fix, and I don't think we should gate those behind getting agreement on refactoring concerns"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6711178192",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Without deferring witness copying, the PR makes witness verification costlier in peak heap and runtime than on master",
      "quote": "I think the fix is needed here, since without it this PR makes witness verification costlier than on master. @sipa, I know how much the PR already carries, but would you take the commit, adapted howev",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined, pointing out deserialization savings outweigh verification costs and overall block processing time decreases",
      "author_replies": ["c:6745317376"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6745317376",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, it makes validation seen in isolation in some cases more expensive, but simultaneously makes deserialization even more cheaper"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4516950679",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Compiling to a byte loop instead of memcpy on GCC 13.3 causes a performance slowdown",
      "quote": "on my gcc13.3, this is compiling to a byte loop, vs memcpy, which is causing a bit of a slowdown.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author prefers to ignore as Guix builds are unaffected and it only affects transient from-source builds",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4517829342"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4517829342",
      "status_by_quote": "If guix is not affected, my preference is to ignore the issue. It doesn't affect production binaries, and is a transient problem for from-source builds."
    }
